$comment: The Rust reserved-word set the identifier derivation of FR-055 refuses or escapes. Pinned here with its provenance so a toolchain upgrade that adds a keyword is a visible diff rather than a silent miscompile (FR-055-CON-2). `noRawForm` is the subset with no `r#` form: those are refusals, because renaming them would change a wire name the contract fixed.
provenance: Transcribed from the Rust Reference, 'Keywords' — strict, reserved and weak keyword tables for edition 2021 — as shipped with the toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml. `noRawForm` is the set the Reference names as having no raw-identifier form.
